trusted_statements: BrushEngine, AutoIntent, Vector/DAB representations, Canonical semantics, and accepted three-platform input behavior remain unchanged.
CanonicalVisible remains the sole authority that retires a committed preview session.
A viewport gesture changes the per-view camera and must invalidate the Canonical presentation without mutating the shared semantic document.
Windows may defer GPU presentation from input callbacks, but the render pump must eventually present every current viewport state and every accepted canonical commit.
The independent Windows preview surface remains presentation-only and must not receive pointer ownership from the overlay.
authorized_goal: Repair Windows viewport-driven Canonical refresh and the first-post-pinch CanonicalVisible preview retirement path, with explicit regression evidence and physical verification inputs.
forbidden_authority_expansion: No Vector/DAB semantic or geometry redesign.
No Windows surface-provider or DirectComposition architecture redesign.
No Debug UI, RuntimeFacade product-control, Undo/Redo, Arc protocol, or input arbitration redesign.
